summary_en: 17,000 shares (1.63% of S/O ex-treasury) acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-25 at ¥13,590/share, total ¥231.0M. Execution window 08:45 JST single session. Part of ¥510M, 34,000-share buyback program authorized 2026-05-15 (execution period July 1 – December 31, 2026).
title_en: Notice of Self-Conducted Share Acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 (Negotiated Off-Exchange Transaction)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-24, Iwabuchi Corporation's Board of Directors (meeting 2026-05-15) approved a framework under the Companies Act § 156 for treasury-share acquisition. The company has executed a specific block purchase via ToSTNeT-3 negotiated off-exchange transaction on 2026-08-25 at the close price of ¥13,590/share. The block consists of 17,000 shares (1.63% of issued shares excluding treasury) with a total outlay not to exceed ¥231,030,000. This block is part of a larger authorized program (34,000 shares, ¥510M ceiling) spanning 2026-07-01 to 2026-12-31. Results are to be disclosed at 08:45 JST on 2026-08-25 following transaction close. As of 2026-08-24, no shares had been acquired under the program; the company held 58,433 treasury shares out of 1,100,000 issued.
